verses.en: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.pt: Isaque, pois, chamou Jacó, e o abençoou, e ordenou-lhe, dizendo: Não tomes mulher dentre as filhas de Canaã.
verses.en_web: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: Then Isaac sent for Jacob, and blessing him, said, Do not take a wife from among the women of Canaan;

verses.en: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, vai a Padã-Arã, à casa de Betuel, pai de tua mãe, e toma de lá uma mulher dentre as filhas de Labão, irmão de tua mãe.
verses.en_web: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
verses.en_bbe: But go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and there get yourself a wife from the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.

verses.en: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
verses.pt: Deus Todo-Poderoso te abençoe, te faça frutificar e te multiplique, para que venhas a ser uma multidão de povos; seu
verses.en_web: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,
verses.en_bbe: And may God, the Ruler of all, give you his blessing, giving you fruit and increase, so that you may become an army of peoples.

verses.en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
verses.pt: e te dê a bênção de Abraão, a ti e à tua descendência contigo, para que herdes a terra de tuas peregrinaçoes, que Deus deu a Abraão.
verses.en_web: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you, and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”
verses.en_bbe: And may God give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your seed, so that the land of your wanderings, which God gave to Abraham, may be your heritage.

verses.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
verses.pt: Assim despediu Isaque a Jacó, o qual foi a Padã-Arã, a Labão, filho de Betuel, arameu, irmão de Rebeca, mãe de Jacó e de Esaú.
verses.en_web: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, Rebekah’s brother, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
verses.en_bbe: So Isaac sent Jacob away: and he went to Paddan-aram, to Laban, son of Bethuel the Aramaean, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.

verses.en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
verses.pt: Ora, viu Esaú que Isaque abençoara a Jacó, e o enviara a Padã-Arã, para tomar de lá mulher para si, e que, abençoando-o, lhe ordenara, dizendo: Não tomes mulher dentre as filhas de Canaã,
verses.en_web: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan,”
verses.en_bbe: So when Esau saw that Isaac had given Jacob his blessing, and sent him away to Paddan-aram to get a wife for himself there, blessing him and saying to him, Do not take a wife from among the women of Canaan;

verses.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;
verses.pt: e que Jacó, obedecendo a seu pai e a sua mãe, fora a Padã- Arã;
verses.en_web: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.
verses.en_bbe: And that Jacob had done as his father and mother said and had gone to Paddan-aram;

verses.en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
verses.pt: vendo também Esaú que as filhas de Canaã eram más aos olhos de Isaque seu pai,
verses.en_web: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.
verses.en_bbe: It was clear to Esau that his father had no love for the women of Canaan,

verses.en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
verses.pt: foi-se Esaú a Ismael e, além das mulheres que já tinha, tomou por mulher a Maalate, filha de Ismael, filho de Abraão, irmã de Nebaiote.
verses.en_web: Esau went to Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
verses.en_bbe: So Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, the daughter of Abraham's son Ishmael, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.

verses.en: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.pt: Partiu, pois, Jacó de Beer-Seba e se foi em direção a Harã;
verses.en_web: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.en_bbe: So Jacob went out from Beer-sheba to go to Haran.

verses.en: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.pt: e chegou a um lugar onde passou a noite, porque o sol já se havia posto; e, tomando uma das pedras do lugar e pondo-a debaixo da cabeça, deitou-se ali para dormir.
verses.en_web: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.en_bbe: And coming to a certain place, he made it his resting-place for the night, for the sun had gone down; and he took one of the stones which were there, and putting it under his head he went to sleep in that place.

verses.en: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verses.pt: Então sonhou: estava posta sobre a terra uma escada, cujo topo chegava ao céu; e eis que os anjos de Deus subiam e desciam por ela;
verses.en_web: He dreamed. Behold, a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verses.en_bbe: And he had a dream, and in his dream he saw steps stretching from earth to heaven, and the angels of God were going up and down on them.

verses.en: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
verses.pt: por cima dela estava o Senhor, que disse: Eu sou o Senhor, o Deus de Abraão teu pai, e o Deus de Isaque; esta terra em que estás deitado, eu a darei a ti e à tua descendência;
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. The land whereon you lie, to you will I give it, and to your offspring.
verses.en_bbe: And he saw the Lord by his side, saying, I am the Lord, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac: I will give to you and to your seed this land on which you are sleeping.

verses.en: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.pt: e a tua descendência será como o pó da terra; dilatar-te-ás para o ocidente, para o oriente, para o norte e para o sul; por meio de ti e da tua descendência serão benditas todas as famílias da terra.
verses.en_web: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring will all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.en_bbe: Your seed will be like the dust of the earth, covering all the land to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south: you and your seed will be a name of blessing to all the families of the earth.

verses.en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
verses.pt: Eis que estou contigo, e te guardarei por onde quer que fores, e te farei tornar a esta terra; pois não te deixarei até que haja cumprido aquilo de que te tenho falado.
verses.en_web: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And truly, I will be with you, and will keep you wherever you go, guiding you back again to this land; and I will not give you up till I have done what I have said to you.

verses.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
verses.pt: Ao acordar Jacó do seu sono, disse: Realmente o Senhor está neste lugar; e eu não o sabia.
verses.en_web: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob, awaking from his sleep, said, Truly, the Lord is in this place and I was not conscious of it.

verses.en: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
verses.pt: E temeu, e disse: Quão terrível é este lugar! Este não é outro lugar senão a casa de Deus; e esta é a porta dos céus.
verses.en_web: He was afraid, and said, “How dreadful is this place! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
verses.en_bbe: And fear came on him, and he said, This is a holy place; this is nothing less than the house of God and the doorway of heaven.

verses.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verses.pt: Jacó levantou-se de manhã cedo, tomou a pedra que pusera debaixo da cabeça, e a pôs como coluna; e derramou-lhe azeite em cima.
verses.en_web: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.
verses.en_bbe: And early in the morning Jacob took the stone which had been under his head, and put it up as a pillar and put oil on it.

verses.en: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
verses.pt: E chamou aquele lugar Betel; porém o nome da cidade antes era Luz.
verses.en_web: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave that place the name of Beth-el, but before that time the town was named Luz.

verses.en: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
verses.pt: Fez também Jacó um voto, dizendo: Se Deus for comigo e me guardar neste caminho que vou seguindo, e me der pão para comer e vestes para vestir,
verses.en_web: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob took an oath, and said, If God will be with me, and keep me safe on my journey, and give me food and clothing to put on,

verses.en: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:
verses.pt: de modo que eu volte em paz à casa de meu pai, e se o Senhor for o meu Deus,
verses.en_web: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,
verses.en_bbe: So that I come again to my father's house in peace, then I will take the Lord to be my God,

verses.en: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
verses.pt: então esta pedra que tenho posto como coluna será casa de Deus; e de tudo quanto me deres, certamente te darei o dízimo.
verses.en_web: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And this stone which I have put up for a pillar will be God's house: and of all you give me, I will give a tenth part to you.
